notes: The Ultimate Pop/Rock Fake Book (Hal Leonard, compiled by Joel Whitburn, (c)1986, ISBN 0-88188-572-X; this is the first-edition/'Ultimate Pop/Rock' printing, 330+ pages). Index = 'Alphabetical Listing' on pdf pages 4-13 (one 3-column table per page: printed page | title | artist | Billboard year/peak), OCR at 300 dpi (tesseract psm 6 tsv, split by column x-position), then fixed by eye against page images. Artists come from that index (the tune pages themselves print only title and writers, no performer credit); where a song lists several recording artists only the first is kept. Composers not recorded. Offset is 0 (printed = pdf page) up to pdf 291; from printed 292-320 the scan is out of order: odd printed pages 293-319 sit at pdf (p+291)/2 (pdf 292-305) and even printed pages 320 down to 292 sit reversed at pdf 466-p/2 (pdf 306-320); pdf 321-335 are identity again. 'page' is the printed number from the index, 'pdfPage' is the real PDF page. Tail mapping verified by title OCR on many pages. conf high = title found on the pdfPage by OCR; med = tune is not first on page or OCR title unreadable (second tunes on shared pages), page taken from index. Checked: ~210 entries by OCR, plus eyeballed 3 pages (28, 302, 336).
